units.contents:
[Unit]
Description=Booty: install Bluefin Server 20260927.123 to /dev/nvme0n1
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target run-bluefin-boot.mount
Requires=run-bluefin-boot.mount

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/systemd-sysinstall --erase=yes --confirm=no --variables=yes --reboot=yes --definitions=/run/bluefin/boot/bluefin/repart.d --kernel=/run/bluefin/boot/EFI/Linux/bluefin-server-20260927.123.efi /dev/nvme0n1

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
units.name: booty-install.service
